data.title: SLS Dubai Hotel & Residences
data.about:
SLS is the home of the unprecedented experience. Culinary creativity, dramatic interiors, and surprising pleasures. With excellent engineers, architects, creators and culinary specialists, SLS is foreseeing, developing and forming the fate of lavish way of living life. Choose from Studios, 1 BR Lofts, 1 BR Duplex, 2 BR Lofts, and 2 BR Duplex.

SLS has been intended to flawlessly spin a mysterious assortment of services and experiences that complement the lavish lifestyle; an all-encompassing way to deal with extravagant living that is fastidiously curated and made to guarantee that our visitors will never feel the need to leave. It is indeed a play area wherein you can eat, live, love, play and live an exciting lifestyle. The SLS dream is growing and developing, reconsidered through the innovative dreams of a differing group of driving craftsmen and gourmet specialists.

location_tile.title: Situated in the Downtown District, the property offers fabulous, unhindered perspectives on the world ‘s tallest structure Burj Khalifa and the picturesque Dubai Creek.
location_tile.heading: location
location_tile.description:
Two wonderful infinity-edge pools on the top of the 75-storey tower offering exceptional 360-degree views of Dubai, making the pools among the most unique not only in the city but all around the world.

  • 3 Minutes – Dubai Mall & Burj Khalifa
  • 10 Minutes – Dubai International Airport
  • 5 Minutes – DIFC
  • 15 Minutes – Burj Al Arab
  • 5 Minutes – Meydan One Mall
